summary: 1.0.70 Windows COM4: first read got no response (BAND pressed early), the next read completed but failed the checksum. ADMS-10 1.0.1.0 REA: protocol is 10-byte AH51G ID, ACK, 65216 data + 1 checksum byte (sum of ID+data), identical to CHIRP's layout; ADMS validates the AH51G ID, CHIRP does not, so a stray byte ahead of the ID shifts the image and fails the checksum. Override flushes input, resyncs on AH51G, and explains the checksum failure.
title: Checksum Failed [0000-FEC9 (@FECA)] on read
